LESSON: ARABIC ALPHABET 1.0 QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.
